name: sac-initial-temperature-2026-10-20
hypothesis: Default alpha initialization1 is large relative to observed training rewards and decays over many updates; a lower initial automatic entropy temperature may reduce startup soft-target transients. Saved Q offsets are not causal proof. Test one fixed candidate, no grid.
selection_basis: Order-of-magnitude hypothesis from completed training replay rewards and logged alpha trajectory only; no new validation/test-based temperature search
selection_metric: Unchanged equal-weight mean validation net return; selected and final weights independently reported

screen_gate.failure: Stop seed11 screen; no confirmation, additional steps or temperature sweep

confirmation_gate.interpretation: Repeated development gates only; frozen prospective comparison remains required

constraints.isolation: Only initial learned alpha changes. Same initial actor/critic seeded weights, automatic adaptation algorithm/learning rate, target entropy, raw reward, preprocessing, features, data, actions, costs and training budgets.
constraints.interpretation: Initial exploration and soft-value targets change; not an assertion of identical optimization trajectories or proof of a pure numerical-conditioning fix. Do not add reward scaling or shaping.
constraints.control_reproduction: Compare fresh default final/selected model tensors and numerical checkpoint scores against the prior full-state SAC seed11 run; report any discrepancy before interpreting temperature effect.
constraints.splits: Train through2020, repeated development2021-2023 only. Never open/evaluate2024-September2026.
constraints.short_side: Reconcile long/short costs and marked P&L; report joint positive total return AND net short profit for ex-post falling stocks. Future labels reporting-only, never sampling, rewards, inputs or checkpoint selection.
constraints.limitations: Survivor stocks, revised Yahoo data, correlated validation and multiple prior searches. No brokerage orders or benchmark-success claim from a selected peak.

execution.training_location: Google Colab only; actual default Python checked before dependency sync
